_comment: S04.12 public attestation. A host may be named in a works-with claim ONLY if it appears in `hosts` below. This file is an allowlist, never a denylist: a consumer that iterates `hosts` cannot accidentally name an untested route. `not_evidenced` is documentation, not a source — it exists so untested hosts are named rather than silently absent. Private transcripts stay in the workspace and never ship; this attestation carries no machine paths.
method: Executed against a clean `git clone` of the published remote at tip 9ef2fd5, taken outside the private workspace so no private sibling was reachable.

hosts.rollback_check: Host plugin config diffed byte-identical against a pre-test copy; zero residual references after removal.

hosts.backed_by: AGENTS.md at the clone root; no manifest required

one_skill_run.note: Returned the skill's purpose and its refusal boundary unprompted.

hosts.rollback_check: No host state is written by the open-clone route; removing the clone is the whole rollback.

not_evidenced.reason: `command -v codex` returned nothing on the machine that produced this attestation.
not_evidenced.documented_as: A conditional in docs/HOSTS.md with a stated fallback: if the build has no `plugin` subcommands, open the clone and Codex reads the SKILL.md tree.

not_evidenced.reason: `command -v agy` returned nothing on the machine that produced this attestation.
not_evidenced.documented_as: A conditional in docs/HOSTS.md with a stated fallback: open the clone as the workspace.

not_evidenced.reason: `command -v gemini` returned nothing on the machine that produced this attestation.
not_evidenced.backed_by: GEMINI.md at the clone root (a symlink to AGENTS.md)
not_evidenced.documented_as: Named in docs/HOSTS.md only as a pointer for Gemini-family hosts, with no install command.

policy.untested_is_not_failed: An untested route may be documented as a conditional with a stated fallback. It may not appear in a badge, a host table's works-with column, or a launch claim.
policy.failed_is_removed: A route that is executed and fails is removed from the documentation, not softened.
